item.title: Portland police chief cries, confirms DHS report of Tren de Aragua ties in Border Patrol shooting
item.description: Portland Police Chief Bob Day appeared to wipe away tears when addressing reports from the U.S. Department of Homeland Security that the suspects shot by Border Patrol agents during a targeted immigration enforcement operation were affiliated with Tren de Aragua. #Portlandpolice #TrendeAragua #BorderPatrol #immigrationenforcement #DHS

item.title: Oklahoma city council rejects proposal to build 15-acre Islamic center, mosque
item.description: City officials in Oklahoma have rejected a plan to build a 15-acre development with an Islamic center and mosque. #Oklahoma #Islam #Mosque

item.title: Iran temporarily shut airspace as strains deepen with US; Qatar base personnel asked to evacuate
item.description: Iran abruptly shut down its airspace to commercial traffic for over four hours early Thursday amid heightened tensions with the United States over Tehran’s violent crackdown on nationwide protests, prompting global aviation reroutes. Separately, the U.S. reportedly advised some personnel at a key military base in Qatar to evacuate. #USIranTensions #IranAirspace #USBaseinQatar #IranProtests #ErfanSoltan #PresidentTrump

item.title: Democratic senator says he prays for Trump, president is 'not my enemy'
item.description: A Democratic senator recently told a recent gathering that he prays for Republican President Donald Trump and does not consider him to be “my enemy.” #Trump #Coons #faith #politics #prayer #church #Washington #Congress #bills

item.title: Trump threatens to invoke Insurrection Act amid unrest after second ICE-involved shooting
item.description: President Donald Trump threatened to invoke the Insurrection Act of 1807 on Thursday to restore order amid ongoing riots against U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officials in Minneapolis. #DonaldTrump #Minnesota #Minneapolis #ICE #TimWalz

item.title: Birthright citizenship, conversion therapy ban, trans sports: 5 Supreme Court decisions to watch in 2026
item.description: The United States Supreme Court is in the midst of a term that includes several high-profile cases on issues including religious liberty, trans-identified male athletes competing in girls' sports and the harms caused to female athletes, and birthright citizenship. Here are five major Supreme Court decisions to look out for in 2026. #SupremeCourt #transgender #religiousfreedom #Trump #birthrightcitizenship #sports #Colorado

item.title: Evangelical leader criticizes Trump for flipping off factory worker: 'Coarsening of civic conduct'
item.description: A prominent conservative Evangelical political leader has criticized President Donald Trump's explicit gesture to a Ford factory worker in Michigan this week, calling out the "coarsening of our civic conduct." #DonaldTrump #UAW #Michigan

item.title: Shooting at Greg Locke’s home sparked by 'beef' between stepson and shooter: prosecutor
item.description: A 2024 shooting at the former home of controversial Tennessee Pastor Greg Locke, which forced him to relocate, was sparked by a “beef” between the shooter and his 17-year-old stepson and was not an attack on the pastor or his ministry, according to the Wilson County District Attorney’s Office. #GregLocke #TylerPoole #GlobalVisionBibleChurch #Shooting

item.title: Lily Phillips responds to critics who question her faith, won't quit making porn
item.description: Porn star Lily Phillips, whose rebaptism has drawn mixed reactions from Christians, responded to critics who have questioned her commitment to rebuilding her relationship with God in light of her plans to continue creating pornographic and sexually explicit content. #LilyPhillips #Christian #baptism #OnlyFans #porn #sin

item.title: Karoline Leavitt blames 'deranged' Democrat officials for inflaming violence against ICE
item.description: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt accused Democratic elected officials Thursday of inflaming violence against federal law enforcement, but stopped short of revealing how much more President Donald Trump will tolerate before invoking the Insurrection Act of 1807. #KarolineLeavitt #WhiteHouse #Minneapolis #ICE #InsurrectionAct #DonaldTrump
